producer.note: AI output; attributes are unverified until the brand confirms them.

proposals.title: 28 shoppers asked about sensitive ears
proposals.summary: Shoppers keep asking about itching, allergies and nickel. 8 earrings are stainless steel all the way through, but no ad says so. Launch an "All-steel gold earrings" ad that states the metal. It makes no hypoallergenic or nickel-free claim, because stainless steel contains some nickel.

evidence.label: Stainless steel earrings
evidence.value: Large Classic Hoop Earrings, Medium Classic Hoop Earrings, Classic Huggie Earrings, Everyday Tube Hoop Earrings, Mini Huggie Earrings, Twisted Huggie Earrings, Teardrop Earrings, Chain Threader Earrings (from ₹1,599)

evidence.label: Claim check
evidence.value: Ad states the metal only; no 'hypoallergenic' or 'nickel-free'

examples: I react to most earrings, help
sensitive ears wale ke liye kya acha hai
mere kaan sensitive hain, koi studs batao
proposals.impact: New ad group for shoppers asking about sensitive ears; rail of stainless steel earrings

ad_creative.title: All-steel gold earrings
ad_creative.body: One metal throughout, 18K gold plated. From ₹1,599.

proposals.title: Add "waterproof" to 18 SKUs
proposals.summary: 18 gold-plated steel SKUs say "shower-proof" or "pool-safe" in their copy, but the water_resistant attribute is empty, so the agent can't claim it and the ad feed can't match waterproof queries.

evidence.label: SKUs with the claim only in prose

examples: can my kid wear them in the pool
proposals.impact: Waterproof rail and agent answers can include these SKUs once confirmed

proposals.title: Keep Layered Chain Necklace Set out of the "Office minimal" rail as a brand rule
proposals.summary: The AI already ranks it out of this rail; approving makes that permanent even if rankings change. Returns are 22% from this context vs 8% overall. Top reason: "too long" (67%). Suggest Snake Chain Necklace instead.
examples: Too long for my office shirts, the longest chain hangs weird
Tangles every single time I take it off
proposals.impact: Fewer returns in this context; kept revenue per click up

proposals.title: Pause the agent on "Wedding guest & gifting" and test a jhumka-first page
proposals.summary: This ad group converts 1.3% of ad clicks to orders vs 2.6% across ChatGPT ads, and keeps ₹30 per click vs ₹54. Pause the agent here and spend it where it lifts conversion and kept revenue.
proposals.impact: Agent cost saved; rail-only page for this context
